tools.name: smseveryone_get_account
tools.description: Show the SMS Everyone account: user id, remaining SMS credits, whether unicode (emoji, non-English text) is enabled and whether international messaging is allowed. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/RetrieveUserSettings.

tools.name: smseveryone_get_campaign_status
tools.description: Show whether a sent or scheduled campaign is Scheduled, Running, Paused or Deleted. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/campaign with Action status.

tools.name: smseveryone_get_delivery_status
tools.description: Delivery receipts of a campaign: one entry per destination with a timestamp, a DeliveryReceiptStatusId and a carrier code. Pass destination to see one number only. An empty list means no receipt has arrived yet (carriers can take up to 24 hours) or the campaign id is not on this account. SMS Everyon

tools.name: smseveryone_list_replies
tools.description: List SMS replies received on the account: received time, the sender's number (Originator), the account number it was sent to (Recipient), the text and a reference id. Always asks for a time window (the last `days` days, 1 to 7, counted back to 12am yesterday for 1, or a date range of at most 30 days

tools.name: smseveryone_list_optouts
tools.description: List phone numbers in the account's optout database (messages to them are never sent): number, date added, reason. The API returns the whole list; this tool shows the first `limit` entries and the total. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/optouts with Action list.

tools.name: smseveryone_list_contact_lists
tools.description: List the stored lists (CRM groups) of mobile numbers: list id (CrmId), description and number count. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/crm with Action list.

tools.name: smseveryone_get_contact_list
tools.description: Show the mobile numbers stored in one list. The API returns the whole list; this tool shows the first `limit` numbers and the total count. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/crm with Action details.

tools.name: smseveryone_send_sms
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS REAL SMS to real people and SPENDS CREDITS from the user's SMS Everyone account; a sent message cannot be recalled (a campaign scheduled for later can be cancelled with cancel_campaign). One message text to 1 to 25 phone numbers in international format without "+" (e.g. 61400123456 for

tools.name: smseveryone_cancel_campaign
tools.description: WRITE: deletes a scheduled SMS campaign so it is not sent. Only works before the campaign start time (afterwards SMS Everyone refuses it with an error code). It cannot be undone. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/campaign with Action delete.

tools.name: smseveryone_pause_campaign
tools.description: WRITE: pauses a scheduled campaign (or one that is sending; SMS Everyone sends over 1000 messages a second, so a running campaign usually finishes first). A campaign scheduled in the past cannot be paused. This server has no way to resume it: the user must do that in SMS Everyone. SMS Everyone REST:

tools.name: smseveryone_add_optouts
tools.description: WRITE: adds 1 to 25 phone numbers to the account's optout database, so no later campaign is sent to them. This server cannot opt a number back in. Do it only when the user asks. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/optouts with Action add.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smseveryone_get_account, smseveryone_get_campaign_status, smseveryone_get_delivery_status, smseveryone_list_replies, smseveryone_list_optouts, smseveryone_list_contact_lists, smseveryone_get_contact_list, smseveryone_send_sms · Private data: smseveryone_list_optouts, smseveryone_list_contact_lists, smseveryone_get_contact_list, smseveryone_add_optouts · Public sink: smseveryone_get_account, smseveryone_get_campaign_status, smseveryone_get_delivery_status, smseveryone_list_replies, smseveryone_list_optouts, smseveryone_list_contact_lists, smseveryone_get_contact_list, smseveryone_send_sms, smseveryone_cancel_campaign, smseveryone_pause_campaign, smseveryone_add_optouts · Destructive: smseveryone_send_sms, smseveryone_cancel_campaign.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
